title: A divider of two resistors with labels and a ground symbol
how: R at (100, 50): pin 1 at y - 3.81 = 46.19 and pin 2 at y + 3.81 = 53.81; R2 at (100, 70): pins at 66.19 and 73.81; the ground symbol at (100, 80) has its pin on its own point;
wires: 46.19 up to 40 (label VIN at its end), 53.81 down to 66.19 (label MID in the middle), 73.81 down to 80 (the ground pin at its end) = 3 wires;
parts: R1 and R2 (power symbols are not parts) = 2; nets: /VIN holds R1.1 only but has a name, /MID holds R1.2 and R2.1, GND holds R2.2 and the power pin = 3 nets;
one sheet in the model; no sheet symbol, so none read; 2 labels.
